# Shafwan Ahmed

> Shafwan Ahmed is a full stack software engineer at Famysys in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. He builds production web applications end to end with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js and MySQL, and was previously a ServiceNow Developer (ITSM and HR Service Delivery) at SUMZ Technologies. Smart India Hackathon 2023 Grand Finalist. Open to Software Engineer and Full Stack Developer roles.

Official website: https://shafwan.in/ (the only official site of this Shafwan Ahmed). Email: tshafwan23@gmail.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/shafwan23/. GitHub: https://github.com/Shafwan23. LeetCode: https://leetcode.com/u/Shafwan3/.

## Experience

- Software Engineer, Famysys, Chennai (Nov 2025 – present): production web applications with Next.js, React, TypeScript; RESTful APIs in Node.js and Express.js on MySQL; secure authentication, third-party integrations; testing, Git, deployment and production support.
- ServiceNow Developer, SUMZ Technologies, Chennai (Sep 2024 – Nov 2025): ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change Management), HR Service Delivery, Flow Designer automation, Service Catalog and Service Portal, SLAs, REST and JDBC integrations, Automated Test Framework.
- Full Stack Developer Intern, MYFUNDBOX, remote (Jan 2024 – Jun 2024): login and signup flow, customer dashboard in React and TypeScript, Spring Boot REST integration.
